suggested_fix: No fix required. Every allocation (devm_kzalloc, devm_kcalloc, devm_kasprintf) is NULL-checked before use. The modalias write is bounded: "spi-nor" plus its terminator is 8 bytes, which fits the buffer. The second chip is only added when num_chipselect >= 2, and devm-managed memory is released automatically on every error path.
